brief:
Palestine's Grand Mufti for Jerusalem and Palestinian Territories has called for immediate Arab and international intervention to aid displaced residents in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Tens of thousands of tents have been submerged by torrential rains and flooding in the strip.

The mufti warned that the humanitarian crisis will worsen as the blockade continues and border crossings remain closed, compounding the disaster facing displaced Palestinians sheltering in camps.

title: Palestine's mufti calls for urgent Arab, international action on Gaza floods
